component.title: DataTable
component.purpose: Present dense data as a calm, selectable, keyboard-operable surface whose async states and mobile transformation preserve context.

states.description: A populated, selectable table with sorting, actions, and pagination.
The existing table remains visible while freshness is announced.
Available rows remain useful while incomplete refresh is explicit.
The collection explains what to do next when there are no rows.
The error is honest and retryable without discarding controls.
Access limitations are explicit and actionable.

claims.statement: Selection is exposed through named checkboxes rather than hover-only affordances.
Refreshing keeps the table visible while announcing the update state.
Request failure exposes a named retry action and leaves the query controls available.
Narrow screens transform each row into a labelled card without changing reading order.
